validity.recommendation: Check the stage two length. The release says 54.5 km and the sheet says 54.8 km.
validity.researcher_notes: The April 2022 release states stage two as 54.5 km of offtake pipe from Kirillov to Lipin Bor. The sheet length is 54.8 km. The gap is small and the release is a plan figure.
